summary: SAB Biotherapeutics entered a Master Manufacturing Services Agreement with Emergent BioSolutions Canada for clinical/commercial manufacturing of SAB-142. No stake, price/share, premium, or board recommendation. The MSA has a five-year term post-FDA approval with a $36M minimum spend, termination provisions for breach/insolvency, and exclusive manufacturing rights for Emergent. This is a routine supply contract — not a special situation. What to watch: standard execution risk under the supply agreement.
